chunks: Al-Sakūnī narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said: ʿAlī عليه السلام said:

Hoarding in times of abundance is for forty days, and in hardship and affliction, three days. So whatever exceeds forty days in times of abundance, its owner is accursed; and whatever exceeds three days in hardship, its owner is accursed.

key_terms.الشِّدَّةِ: a time of hardship and strain
key_terms.الْحُكْرَةُ: hoarding or withholding goods from the market
key_terms.الْخِصْبِ: a time of abundance and ease in provisions

ai.seo_question: What does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about hoarding goods in times of abundance and hardship?
ai.summary: This hadith sets limits on hoarding goods, distinguishing between times of abundance and times of hardship. It condemns extending hoarding beyond those limits, showing the grave moral and legal seriousness of withholding needed provisions from the community.
